title: Sparkly cup of hot cocoa
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sparkles around cup -->
  <g fill='#FFE566'>
    <path d='M18 22 l2 5 5 2 -5 2 -2 5 -2 -5 -5 -2 5 -2z'/>
    <path d='M82 18 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M12 55 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M88 50 l1.5 3.5 3.5 1.5 -3.5 1.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5 -3.5 -3.5 -1.5 3.5 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M25 82 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1z'/>
    <path d='M75 80 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1z'/>
  </g>

  <!-- steam -->
  <g fill='none' stroke='#FFB3C7' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'>
    <path d='M38 28 q-3 -6 1 -11 q4 -5 1 -10'/>
    <path d='M50 25 q-3 -6 1 -11 q4 -5 1 -10'/>

  <path d='M28 42 L30 78 Q50 86 70 78 L72 42 Z' fill='#E84A5F'/>
  <!-- cup lighter edge -->
  <path d='M28 42 L30 78 Q50 86 70 78 L72 42 Z' fill='none' stroke='#FF7B8A' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- cup front highlight -->
  <path d='M34 46 L35.5 74 Q50 79 64.5 74 L66 46 Z' fill='#F25C6E' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- handle -->
  <path d='M72 50 Q88 50 88 62 Q88 72 72 72' fill='none' stroke='#E84A5F' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 50 Q86 50 86 62 Q86 70 72 71' fill='none' stroke='#FF7B8A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- cocoa surface -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='21' ry='5.5' fill='#6B3A2A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='18' ry='4' fill='#8B5A3A'/>

  <!-- liquid edge highlight -->

  <!-- marshmallows -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='41' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='41' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='43' rx='4.5' ry='2.8' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#FFF4E0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- cocoa swirl lines -->
  <path d='M38 44 q4 2 8 0 q4 -2 8 0 q4 2 8 0' fill='none' stroke='#A0714F' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- inner sparkle reflections -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='44' r='1' fill='#FFE566' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='45' r='0.8' fill='#FFE566' opacity='0.7'/>
